Gamble Jones Investment Counsel Has Decreased Its Ss&C Technologies Hldgs (SSNC) Holding by $430,520; As Apple (AAPL) Stock Value Declined, Trust Company Of Virginia Raised Position
May 25, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Gamble Jones Investment Counsel decreased its stake in Ss&C Technologies Hldgs (SSNC) by 14.11% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gamble Jones Investment Counsel sold 10,763 shares as the company’s stock rose 29.33% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 65,499 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.65M, down from 76,262 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gamble Jones Investment Counsel who had been investing in Ss&C Technologies Hldgs for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $11.95B market cap company. It closed at $50.17 lastly. It is down 47.28% since May 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 35.73% the S&P500.
Trust Company Of Virginia increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 5.62% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Trust Company Of Virginia bought 5,133 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 96,539 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.34 million, up from 91,406 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Trust Company Of Virginia who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $930.24 billion market cap company.
